#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <cstdio>

using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
    void execute() {
        bool online = (getenv(" ContestMode") == nullptr) && (getenv("ONLINE_JUDGE") == nullptr);
        
        if (online) {
            // For local testing, we'll read from stdin
            inputStream = stdin;
        } else {
            // For contest mode, we'll use the test input
            string testInput = "";
            inputBuffer = testInput;
            inputPos = 0;
            inputStream = nullptr; // Mark that we're using buffer
        }
        
        writer = cout;
        
        long long startNs = clock() * 1000000 / CLOCKS_PER_SEC;
        process();
        writer.flush();
        if (!online) {
            long long elapsed = (clock() * 1000000 / CLOCKS_PER_SEC) - startNs;
            cerr << elapsed << " ms" << endl;
        }
    }
    
private:
    FILE* inputStream;
    ostringstream writer;
    string inputBuffer;
    size_t inputPos;
    
    static const string TEST_INPUT;
    
    void process() {
        int n = nextInt();
        string seqStr = nextToken();
        vector<char> sequence(seqStr.begin(), seqStr.end());
        
        int countV = 0, countK = 0, countE = 0;
        for (char ch : sequence) {
            if (ch == 'V') countV++;
            else if (ch == 'K') countK++;
            else countE++;
        }
        
        // Create 4D dp array: [3][countV+1][countK+1][countE+1]
        vector<vector<vector<vector<int>>>> dp(3, 
            vector<vector<vector<int>>>(countV + 1, 
                vector<vector<int>>(countK + 1, 
                    vector<int>(countE + 1, INT_MAX / 2))));
        
        dp[2][0][0][0] = 0;
        
        // Create positions array
        vector<vector<vector<vector<int>>>> positions(3, 
            vector<vector<vector<int>>>(countV + 1, 
                vector<vector<int>>(countK + 1, 
                    vector<int>(countE + 1, -1))));
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= countV; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= countK; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k <= countE; k++) {
                    for (int t = 0; t < 3; t++) {
                        positions[t][i][j][k] = locate(sequence, i, j, k, t);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= countV; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= countK; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k <= countE; k++) {
                    if (i + 1 <= countV && positions[0][i][j][k] != -1) {
                        int val = positions[0][i][j][k];
                        dp[0][i + 1][j][k] = min(dp[0][i + 1][j][k], val + dp[2][i][j][k]);
                        dp[0][i + 1][j][k] = min(dp[0][i + 1][j][k], val + dp[1][i][j][k]);
                        dp[0][i + 1][j][k] = min(dp[0][i + 1][j][k], val + dp[0][i][j][k]);
                    }
                    if (j + 1 <= countK && positions[1][i][j][k] != -1) {
                        int val = positions[1][i][j][k];
                        dp[1][i][j + 1][k] = min(dp[1][i][j + 1][k], val + dp[2][i][j][k]);
                        dp[1][i][j + 1][k] = min(dp[1][i][j + 1][k], val + dp[1][i][j][k]);
                    }
                    if (k + 1 <= countE && positions[2][i][j][k] != -1) {
                        int val = positions[2][i][j][k];
                        dp[2][i][j][k + 1] = min(dp[2][i][j][k + 1], val + dp[0][i][j][k]);
                        dp[2][i][j][k + 1] = min(dp[2][i][j][k + 1], val + dp[1][i][j][k]);
                        dp[2][i][j][k + 1] = min(dp[2][i][j][k + 1], val + dp[2][i][j][k]);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        int ans = min(dp[0][countV][countK][countE],
                     min(dp[1][countV][countK][countE], dp[2][countV][countK][countE]));
        cout << ans << endl;
    }
    
    int locate(const vector<char>& seq, int needV, int needK, int needE, int t) {
        int idx = 0;
        for (char ch : seq) {
            if (ch == 'V') {
                if (needV == 0) {
                    if (t == 0) return idx;
                    idx++;
                } else {
                    needV--;
                }
            } else if (ch == 'K') {
                if (needK == 0) {
                    if (t == 1) return idx;
                    idx++;
                } else {
                    needK--;
                }
            } else {
                if (needE == 0) {
                    if (t == 2) return idx;
                    idx++;
                } else {
                    needE--;
                }
            }
        }
        return -1;
    }
    
    int nextByte() {
        if (inputStream) {
            return fgetc(inputStream);
        } else {
            if (inputPos >= inputBuffer.size()) return -1;
            return inputBuffer[inputPos++];
        }
    }
    
    bool isWhitespace(int c) {
        return c < 33 || c > 126;
    }
    
    int advance() {
        int c;
        while ((c = nextByte()) != -1 && isWhitespace(c));
        return c;
    }
    
    string nextToken() {
        int c = advance();
        string sb;
        while (!isWhitespace(c)) {
            sb += (char)c;
            c = nextByte();
        }
        return sb;
    }
    
    int nextInt() {
        int c = advance();
        bool neg = false;
        if (c == '-') {
            neg = true;
            c = nextByte();
        }
        int val = 0;
        while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
            val = val * 10 + (c - '0');
            c = nextByte();
        }
        return neg ? -val : val;
    }
};

const string Solution::TEST_INPUT = "";

int main() {
    Solution sol;
    sol.execute();
    return 0;
}
